about: The most script and style files web/index.html may load, and their bytes as stored and gzipped (tools/shell_budget.py, run by make check). `files` is the count today: a new file in the shell raises it in the same pull request. The byte budgets are the size measured when they were last set (2026-11-28: 107 files, 3139686 bytes, 903160 gzipped), with no reserve; a pull request that needs more raises them, so the raise shows in its diff (context/performance.md, item 15).
